svg.title: One Annual Client Cohort, Five Nested Stages
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-qualified-client-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: One Annual Client Cohort, Five Nested Stages; subtitle: 200 screened suppliers become 20 signed and served clients.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative mature-year acquisition cohort, not measured conversion data. Every stage is a subset of the preceding stage, counted by unique supplier organization. All 20 final clients receive a full year of services averaging $28,000 each; partial-year starts would require a separate revenue schedule.; caption: 200 to 80 to 40 to 25 to 20 produces 10% end-to-end conversion and $560,000 Base-Case recognized service revenue. Signed service clients are not government contract awards.; stages: label: Screened suppliers; value: 200 distinct prospective client organizations; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Select suppliers with a defined public-sector offering, reachable decision-makers, and a plausible delivery footprint. Count each organization once, even when it pursues multiple solicitations through different purchasing portals.; label: Capability-qualified suppliers; value: 80 organizations; 40% of initial cohort; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Confirm relevant capability evidence, resource availability, and procurement fit. Remove organizations seeking access payments, unsupported certifications, or opportunities they cannot perform with the proposed team.; label: Completed discovery engagements; value: 40 organizations; 50% of qualified cohort; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Complete a structured discovery meeting with an authorized buyer. Establish bid volume, service boundaries, payment capacity, and which activities remain with the client's technical and pricing owners.; label: Issued service proposals; value: 25 organizations; 62.5% of discovery cohort; numeric value: 25.0; detail: Issue scoped service proposals only after reviewing fee structure, conflicts, and delivery effort. Include milestone acceptance, invoice timing, and workload limits rather than promising a government award.; label: Signed and served clients; value: 20 organizations; 80% of proposal cohort; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Deliver the modeled annual service mix: four clients at each of $40,000, $30,000, $28,000, $24,000, and $18,000. Total recognized fees equal $560,000 across 20 clients.

text.title: One Annual Client Cohort, Five Nested Stages
text.tspan: One Annual Client Cohort, Five Nested Stages

rect.title: label: Screened suppliers; value: 200 distinct prospective client organizations; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Select suppliers with a defined public-sector offering, reachable decision-makers, and a plausible delivery footprint. Count each organization once, even when it pursues multiple solicitations through different purchasing portals.

label: Capability-qualified suppliers; value: 80 organizations; 40% of initial cohort; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Confirm relevant capability evidence, resource availability, and procurement fit. Remove organizations seeking access payments, unsupported certifications, or opportunities they cannot perform with the proposed team.

label: Completed discovery engagements; value: 40 organizations; 50% of qualified cohort; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Complete a structured discovery meeting with an authorized buyer. Establish bid volume, service boundaries, payment capacity, and which activities remain with the client's technical and pricing owners.

label: Issued service proposals; value: 25 organizations; 62.5% of discovery cohort; numeric value: 25.0; detail: Issue scoped service proposals only after reviewing fee structure, conflicts, and delivery effort. Include milestone acceptance, invoice timing, and workload limits rather than promising a government award.

label: Signed and served clients; value: 20 organizations; 80% of proposal cohort; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Deliver the modeled annual service mix: four clients at each of $40,000, $30,000, $28,000, $24,000, and $18,000. Total recognized fees equal $560,000 across 20 clients.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative mature-year acquisition cohort, not measured conversion data. Every stage is a subset of the preceding stage, counted by unique supplier organization. All 20 final clients receive a full year of services averaging $28,000 each; partial-year starts would require a separate revenue schedule.
